decontamination_notes: Real fix from pallets/click PR #3769, merged 2026-08-15, after model training cutoffs, so the specific fix is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit 8b44edf (src/click + pyproject.toml + BSD LICENSE). click is dependency-free with lazy version import, so tests run on the base sandbox image with PYTHONPATH=src. The bug: when update_min_steps did not evenly divide (or exceeded) the work, the progress bar froze below completion, leaving the trailing remainder unrendered (e.g. 14/20 for length 20, threshold 7). Hidden tests assert the rendered output of the public click.progressbar reaches the final position; never internal render state. Run with -c /dev/null so the repo's pytest config is ignored.
